# Review Checklist

Use this checklist for agent or human review.

- [ ] The change matches the product spec or stated task.
- [ ] Architecture boundaries remain clear.
- [ ] Tests or verification cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] User-facing states are handled where relevant.
- [ ] Docs were updated when durable knowledge changed.
- [ ] Security and reliability implications were considered.
- [ ] No unrelated refactors or noisy churn were introduced.
